summary: Review found 2 defects related to user_id = 0 placeholders in idempotency endpoints
defects: backend/src/mcp_internal.rs:836 - record_idempotency binds user_id = 0 as a placeholder, violating acceptance criteria "all user_id = 0 and empty-list placeholders replaced"; idempotency keys are not scoped to a user
backend/src/mcp_internal.rs:804-823 - check_idempotency does not filter by user_id, allowing cross-user information leaks if two users use the same operation_id
follow_up: Consider whether idempotency endpoints should be scoped to user_id for security
important_context: The record_idempotency and check_idempotency endpoints are not currently called by any MCP tool, so the impact is limited
The user_id = 0 placeholder is a clear violation of the acceptance criteria
